structural_form.buckingham_note: 1 dimensionless group for {p, C, A}: the law itself, p/(C A^n) = 1. Dimensions therefore fix the units of C but never its value -- C follows from one (A0, p0) anchoring pair, and n is the only transferable dimensionless number of the anchor. Hence an anchor exponent may only be compared as a pure number, and an anchor prefactor must be re-anchored, not copied.

case_implied_exponent.interpretation: the case draws pressure and fragment size independently, so its own pressure-area coupling is statistically zero; a monotone decreasing external p(A) law is structurally absent from the case
